metadata.title: 1970s Soul and Reggae Album Cover Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style portrait featuring a central figure in denim against a stylized cosmic background with bold, rounded typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with an afro, wearing a denim jacket adorned with patches, set against a deep blue background featuring soft, organic cloud-like shapes and a subtle starfield, accompanied by diagonally oriented rounded typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and slightly angled to the right
Typography placed in the upper left quadrant following a diagonal axis
Denim texture contrasting with the smooth, ethereal background
Warm skin tones balanced by cool blue background hues
coreInvariants: Denim jacket with visible stitching and embroidered patches
Soft-focus cosmic background with star-like glints

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up, head and shoulders filling the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and afro, providing a strong dark mass against the blue background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography in the top left, moves down the diagonal text line to the subject's face, then down to the patches on the denim jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and right edges, filled with cosmic textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and denim blue (background and clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and red (found in jacket patches)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, filmic saturation with deep shadows and soft, glowing highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to 1970s film stock color profiles

characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or overlapping characters in the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales and colors (white and yellow).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft, geometric, and friendly 70s aesthetic.
Captures the heavy, rounded display quality of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with an afro wearing a denim jacket with patches, set against a 70s-style blue cosmic background with soft clouds and stars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add rounded bold sans-serif text in off-white and yellow, tilted at a 15-degree upward angle in the top left corner.
